audit_events_actor_membership_consistent.name: audit_events_actor_membership_consistent
audit_events_actor_membership_consistent.value: ("audit_events"."actor_kind" = 'user' and "audit_events"."actor_membership_id" is not null) or ("audit_events"."actor_kind" <> 'user' and "audit_events"."actor_membership_id" is null)

leads_value_currency_pair.name: leads_value_currency_pair
leads_value_currency_pair.value: ("leads"."value_cents" is null and "leads"."currency" is null) or ("leads"."value_cents" is not null and "leads"."currency" is not null)

signals_resolution_state_consistent.name: signals_resolution_state_consistent
signals_resolution_state_consistent.value: ("signals"."status" in ('resolved', 'dismissed') and "signals"."resolved_at" is not null) or ("signals"."status" in ('open', 'acknowledged') and "signals"."resolved_at" is null)

source_records_payload_storage_has_reten.name: source_records_payload_storage_has_retention
source_records_payload_storage_has_reten.value: "source_records"."raw_payload_storage_key" is null or "source_records"."raw_payload_retain_until" is not null
